items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: I asked everybody that. And nobody knew, nobody could answer the question. Miles came closest, he said, “Oh man, my sound, it’s like your sweat.”

ctx.x: Did you have a particular question, you sort of just answered it but it was specific to Miles, but I have a question that I usually ask about improvising, what are you thinking about when you’re improvising. And I almost always get the same basic answer. I’m not going to say what it is, I mean I could, but I wonder if you’ve had questions like that, that you usually find the same answer?

Well yeah. One of them is where does your sound come from. Where does your style come from. I asked everybody that. And nobody knew, nobody could answer the question. Miles came closest, he said, “Oh man, my sound, it’s like your sweat.” It’s like your sweat. So I asked everybody where your sound comes from and where your style comes from. And it makes sense that nobody could answer that because you can’t really see yourself or hear yourself the way other people do. As a matter of fact that’s one of the really…
I have to say that reminds me of — I just had a flashback to when I was a kid and the first time I heard my own voice on a recording — “Oh, that can’t be me.”
